It’s America vs Italy in this quarter-mile drag race! 🇺🇸🇮🇹

Mat’s lining up against the brand-new, twin-turbo hybrid Chevrolet Corvette ZR1X in the legendary plug-in hybrid Ferrari SF90 Stradale. On paper, this is an absolute heavyweight clash of hybrid hypercars - so let’s see how the stats stack up before they hit the runway!

Starting with the Chevy, the Corvette ZR1X pairs a ferocious 5.5-litre twin-turbo flat-plane crank V8 with a front-mounted electric motor to produce a staggering 1,267hp and 1,123Nm of torque! Power is sent to all four wheels and it has an 8-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The whole thing tips the scales at 1,875kg and it costs $240,995

Then we have the Ferrari SF90 Stradale. Behind the driver sits a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8, assisted by three electric motors for a combined out
title: Corvette ZR1X v Ferrari SF90: DRAG RACE
